purpose: Rank candidate opportunities for future financial modeling work without affecting public organic rankings.
admission_checklist: opportunity type is GAME, DEPIN_NODE, or POINTS
required hardware or platform is described
capital requirement is known or explicitly unknown
time and effort characteristics are known or explicitly unknown
withdrawal or reward status is documented
financial model feasibility is GO, PARTIAL, PARKED, or REJECTED

modeling_priority_factors.name: entry_cost_reproducibility
modeling_priority_factors.description: Entry capital can be sourced from on-chain, official API, reputable market API, or explicit official docs.

modeling_priority_factors.name: earning_rate_reproducibility
modeling_priority_factors.description: Reward formula, rate, probability, or production output is public, authorized, and reproducible.

modeling_priority_factors.name: realizable_value_route
modeling_priority_factors.description: Reward value has a lawful transfer, withdrawal, market, or executable quote route.

modeling_priority_factors.name: cost_observability
modeling_priority_factors.description: Transaction, operating, subscription, repair, device, or network costs can be modeled without fake zeroes.

modeling_priority_factors.name: timing_caps_and_change_detection
modeling_priority_factors.description: Caps, seasons, claim cadence, uptime, eligibility windows, and rule changes can be detected or manually reviewed safely.

modeling_priority_factors.name: machine_readability_and_terms_feasibility
modeling_priority_factors.description: Required inputs are on-chain, official API, reputable market API, or otherwise lawfully collectable.

priority_labels.label: MODEL_NEXT
priority_labels.meaning: Candidate appears ready for a Data Feasibility Check and possible adapter work.

priority_labels.label: RESEARCH_MORE
priority_labels.meaning: Candidate is useful for the catalog but needs more evidence before adapter work.

priority_labels.label: WATCHLIST_ONLY
priority_labels.meaning: Candidate may remain public as an opportunity record, but financial ROI must stay unavailable.
